name: Iron Flask and Lemure Trap (CR 6)
body:
Iron Flask and Lemure Trap
CR 6

XP 2,400

Type mechanical; Perception DC 20; Disable Device DC 25

EFFECTS

Trigger touch (moving the iron flask); Reset none

Effect Releases 7 compressed lemures to immediately attack
